```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
combine <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "combine") |>
  mutate(
    position_group = factor(combine_position_group(pos), pos_levels),
    drafted = !is.na(draft_round)
  )
outcomes <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
roster_pos <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position
   FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
# Draft-eligible player-seasons, with whether the combine invited the player and
# whether the draft that year selected him.
funnel <- build_combine_funnel(combine, outcomes) |>
  left_join(roster_pos, by = c("playerId", "season"), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group(position), c(pos_levels, "Position not recorded")))
by_year <- funnel |>
  group_by(draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    drafted_inv = mean(drafted[invited]),
    drafted_uninv = mean(drafted[!invited]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
by_pos_year <- funnel |>
  filter(position_group %in% pos_levels) |>
  group_by(position_group, draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    invited_n = sum(invited),
    drafted_inv = mean(drafted[invited]),
    drafted_uninv = mean(drafted[!invited]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
rates_long <- by_year |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-draft_year, names_to = "group", values_to = "rate") |>
  mutate(
    group = if_else(group == "drafted_inv", "Invited", "Not invited"),
    tip = sprintf("%s, %s: %.1f%% drafted", group, draft_year, 100 * rate)
  )
p <- ggplot(rates_long, aes(draft_year, 100 * rate, colour = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(group, draft_year)), size = 3.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Invited = "#B45309", `Not invited` = "#6B7280")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(by_year$draft_year), max(by_year$draft_year), 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Are invited draft-eligible players drafted more often than uninvited ones?",
    subtitle = "Share of draft-eligible seasons ending in a draft selection that year",
    x = "Draft year",
    y = "Drafted that year",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "invited-players-drafted-rate", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-position
p_pos <- by_pos_year |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(drafted_inv, drafted_uninv), names_to = "group", values_to = "rate") |>
  mutate(
    group = if_else(group == "drafted_inv", "Invited", "Not invited"),
    tip = sprintf("%s, %s, %s: %.1f%% drafted", position_group, group, draft_year, 100 * rate)
  ) |>
  # A position-year with no invitees has no invited rate.
  filter(is.finite(rate)) |>
  ggplot(aes(draft_year, 100 * rate, colour = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, group, draft_year)), size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~position_group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Invited = "#B45309", `Not invited` = "#6B7280")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Does the invited gap show up at every position group?",
    subtitle = "Share drafted that year, invited against not invited, by position group",
    x = "Draft year",
    y = "Drafted that year",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_pos, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 10)
```
